Your practice management solution is the backbone of your accounting firm’s operations. And no other tool in your tech stack has greater potential to harness the power of AI.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Karbon AI and what can it do for my accounting firm?

Karbon AI is a suite of artificial intelligence features built directly into Karbon’s practice management platform. It helps accounting firms work faster and more efficiently by automating time-consuming tasks like drafting client emails, summarizing long email threads, flagging missed time entries, and suggesting team assignments. Because Karbon AI is integrated into your existing workflow — not a separate tool — it can draw on your firm’s real data across clients, jobs, communication, and billing to deliver relevant, contextual suggestions.

Will more features be added to Karbon AI over time?

Yes. The features available today are the foundation of a broader AI roadmap. Karbon is continuously investing in AI-powered capabilities, including AI Agents that can proactively handle repetitive workflows like client onboarding and tax preparation. Karbon’s AI-first approach means your firm will always have access to the latest innovations in practice management AI.

Does Karbon AI cost extra on top of my Karbon subscription?

Karbon AI is currently available to all Karbon customers at no additional cost. If pricing for AI features is introduced in the future, Karbon will communicate any changes to customers in advance.

Is Karbon AI secure? How is my firm’s data protected?

Security was a core requirement in the design of Karbon AI, not an afterthought. Your firm’s data stays within Karbon. It is never shared externally or used to train AI models. Regional data compliance is also in place, meaning data stays in-region (for example, UK data remains in the UK), which is a regulatory requirement in some regions.

What AI technology does Karbon use?

Karbon AI is built on the Azure OpenAI Service, which includes enterprise-grade security and responsible AI safeguards. Karbon evaluates and incorporates the latest AI model advancements on an ongoing basis to ensure firms always benefit from the most capable and reliable AI available.

What do I need to access Karbon AI?

You need an active Karbon subscription to use Karbon AI. All features are available across Karbon’s paid plans.

How is Karbon AI different from general-purpose AI tools like ChatGPT?

General-purpose AI tools operate without any knowledge of your firm. Karbon AI is different because it works within the context of your actual practice data — your clients, jobs, team, communication history, billing, and more. This means AI suggestions in Karbon are grounded in real information about your firm, not generic outputs. As your accounting firm’s practice management platform, Karbon holds more relevant operational context than any standalone AI tool, making its AI capabilities significantly more useful for day-to-day accounting work.

Can my firm control which AI features are turned on?

Yes. Karbon AI is enabled for all users in a firm by default, but account administrators can disable AI functionality through firm settings. As Karbon’s Agent Management System develops, firms will also be able to configure individual AI Agent capabilities — turning specific automations on or off to match their workflows and preferences.

Will Karbon use my firm’s data to train its AI models?

No. Karbon does not use your firm’s data to train AI models, and no data is shared with third parties or used to inform any other Karbon customer’s experience.
